lead: A module's known-gap bullet names the blocker its author hit, not every blocker between there and the feature.
body: A gap that reads as one missing type can hide two more layers behind it, so reading it as a work estimate sizes a slice at a third of its cost. Spend three greps, one per layer — is the member callable, can the pass name the thing, does the pass have the input — before budgeting; `crates/nvs-types/src/intrinsics.rs`'s gap list is where the layered answer for the literal-host check lives.
